t: What ordinary work is ranked against
a: السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَوْ كَالَّذِي يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ
p: As-sāʿī ʿalā-l-armalati wa-l-miskīni ka-l-mujāhidi fī sabīli-Llāh, aw ka-lladhī yaṣūmu-n-nahāra wa yaqūmu-l-layl
m: The one who works to provide for a widow and for the poor is like a man striving in the path of Allah, or like one who fasts the day and stands the night.
